warnings.label: Somerset coast at Porlock Weir
warnings.message:
High tides tomorrow morning may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible Around high tide 
We are entering a sequence of Spring tides that may lead to flooding. Flooding is possible around 06:45 on Friday 11th September. Flooding is forecast to affect locations at Porlock Bay, with low lying land and roads expected to be most affected, particularly around the coastline between Gore Point and Hurlstone Point including Porlock Weir. The first high tide is at 06:45 on Friday with a peak height of 6.12m and a F4 north westerly wind. The second high tide is at 19:00 on Friday with a peak height of 6.37m and a F4 westerly wind 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Avoid coastal roads, footpaths and carparks, which may be flooded . 
This message will be updated by 12:19PM on 10 September 2026 or as the situation changes.

warnings.label: Coast at North Morecambe Bay
warnings.message:
High tides overnight may lead to flooding. 
Although the midday tide today Friday 11 September, is expected to peak just below the Flood Alert threshold, the following tide is forecast to exceed this.
Flooding is possible from 10:30 PM tonight Friday 11 September to 02:30 AM on Saturday 12 September, peaking at 00:30 AM.
Areas most at risk lie within the Sandside area of North Morecambe Bay. Locations most affected will be coastal roads and footpaths. 
We are closely monitoring the situation. 
Avoid beaches and coastal promenades, which may be flooded . Do not drive through flood water or put yourself or others at risk. 
This message will be updated by 05:00PM today Friday 11 September 2026 or as the situation changes.

warnings.message: A flood alert remains in place for tonight's high tide at Hambleton which will peak at 00:45am on 12/09/2026. This flood alert is forecast to remain in place for the following three high tides until Sunday.  This lunchtime's tide (Friday) peaking at 12:30 PM is not forecast to reach the alert threshold.

warnings.label: The tidal Rivers Bure, Ant and Thurne
warnings.description: The tidal Rivers Bure, Ant and Thurne
warnings.message:
High river levels today may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible today, Thursday 10th September. 
We expect to see high water levels around Potter Heigham, Wroxham boat yards and Ferry Road in Horning. River levels will remain high over the next couple of days. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water . Avoid using low lying footpaths which may be flooded. 
This message will be updated by 10:00AM on 11 September 2026 or as the situation changes.
